title: The Lantern Watch
blurb: A chain of hill beacons warns the coast of raiders. One did not light, and nobody will say why.

beats.journal: Hebbel Marchen will not name whose beacon it was until the tally is read aloud. It says Cairnhead: Orin Vane's turn. He is not here.
Nesh Cairnhead did not light the beacon because a man with a tally of his own told her the rota had changed. There are two tallies.
Mabb Hollow saw a man go south past Hollowgate in a hurry, carrying a notched stick. He did not stop, and he did not look like the reeve's man.
Orin Vane cut the second tally himself. Not for raiders: the rota put his beacon on the two nights his mill has to run, and nobody would hear him.

startsWith.name: Warden's Tally
startsWith.description: A notched hazel stick. Whose turn it is to keep which beacon, and the only proof the rota was ever agreed.
